column1: # SPDX-License-Identifier: CC0-1.0
# Public Oblivious DoH targets (RFC 9230) that the network part's engine may use (ADR 0042, W8). A target sees the question but
# not the user's address. Every value has its source in sources.tsv; read and measured on 2026-11-20 (SOURCE).
# Columns:
#   id             short name, lower case
#   host           the target host, as given in targethost
#   path           the target path, as given in targetpath
#   ipv4           bootstrap addresses of the host, comma separated
#   ipv6           bootstrap addresses of the host, comma separated, compressed lower-case form
#   operator       the service's operator as it names itself
#   person         the person or body behind it
#   jurisdictions  ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes: the operator's or person's seat, the hosting company's, any CDN's
#   hosting        the hosting networks, as AS numbers
#   cdn            the CDN in front, as AS numbers
#   filtering      no, or what it filters
#   doh            the same operator's plain DoH URL
#   doh-ipv4       bootstrap addresses of that URL's host
#   doh-ipv6       bootstrap addresses of that URL's host
#   pins           SPKI SHA-256 pins (sha256/BASE64); none published by any operator
#   configs        lower-case hex of the ObliviousDoHConfigs that /.well-known/odohconfigs served on 2026-11-20
#   note           free text
# '-' means none.
cloudflare
column17: The 1.1.1.1 resolver acting as an ODoH target (Cloudflare's docs); the 1.1.1.1 privacy policy does not name ODoH; CR because the IPv6 block 2803:f800::/32 is registered to CloudFlare Latin America S.R.L.
